resources.string: "OpenAI checks the requested language when you connect. This list shows language names, not guaranteed model coverage. Search by name or enter a 2–3 letter language code."
"Moonshine · This model recognizes English only. No automatic language detection or override is needed."
"%1$s · Choose a language to bypass automatic language selection, or choose Auto. Only languages supported by this model and runtime are listed."
"%1$s · The installed model fixes the spoken language. Change the model to change language; automatic detection and language overrides are unavailable."
"%1$s · English-only model. Spoken language is fixed to English; no detection is needed."
"Choose a language to skip detection, or choose Auto. Coverage comes from this model\'s vocabulary."
"Language capabilities are unavailable until a supported model is imported. No language override will be sent."
"Select a language hint, or Auto. A hint guides recognition; it does not prohibit other languages."
"Select a spoken-language hint, or Auto. Select a source explicitly when using the local translation bridge."
"Automatic source language only in this connection. There is no manual language control."
"Detects the spoken language automatically. This translation connection does not accept a source-language override."
"The audio-translation endpoint detects the source automatically; it accepts no language override."
"Select the spoken language for dedicated recognition. Auto uses multilingual mode (10 languages)."
"Select the spoken language to send an explicit recognition hint, or choose Auto."
"Manual spoken-language selection is not available for this model in this app. Recognition uses its default language behavior."
"%1$s · text translation after speech recognition."
"Set up this translation connection and check its languages first."
"Cloud text translation · supported targets from the chosen spoken language."
"Soniox v5 integrated translation; original and translated text are retained separately."
"ML Kit · download spoken and target language packs in Models. Non-English pairs translate through English."
"Choose a known local translation model in Setup to load its languages."
"%1$s: %2$s output languages. The spoken language must also be supported by this translation model."
"English uses audio translation. Arabic needs the separate English → Arabic translation model."
"This path needs English speech and the English → Arabic translation model. Other speech stays CC-only."
